subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?

subject: CVPR? Private Invite to Happy Hour Drinks
text:
Hi [NAME]

I thought there's a good chance you'll be at CVPR this year - and if so,
I'd love to introduce myself in person. I lead Encord's work with physical
AI and robotics companies like Skydio, Zipline, Figure AI, 1x, Rapid
robotics etc. We're helping their AI teams accelerate model development
with high-quality training data and improved pipeline automation, critical
for new use cases/products i.e. object detection or behavioural analysis.

We're hosting a relaxed happy hour for AI/ML leaders on the Friday evening
(June 13th) in Nashville, co-hosted with Lambda and Captions. Let me know
if you'd like to join and I'll send over the private guestlist details.

If you're not familiar, Encord is a Series B ML data platform ($50M
raised), unifying data curation, annotation, and model evaluation for
advanced CV and multimodal teams.

Happy to meet for a coffee if easier, or let me know if you'd like to book
a quick demo of the platform as we'll be on booth #1123.
